title: It was leapyear like now
html_source: In Ireland, it’s tradition that every leap year on the 29th of February, women propose to men and the men are obligated to say yes. Despite this, Molly is the one repeating “yes” as this passage continues and she was the one who said yes to the proposal as well. With the roles reversed, this suggests that Molly has more of a traditionally “masculine” role in her marriage and was forced by traditional relationship conventions to say yes to a marriage she knew would leave her unfulfilled.
